Rage, or rabies, causes acute neurological symptoms and does not establish latency, aligning with the reasoning chain. Hepatitis A virus causes acute hepatitis and resolves without latency, which is also consistent with the reasoning chain. Therefore, Cytomegalovirus is the virus most capable of causing latent infections.
